# local-storefront

> local-storefront runs a Shopify theme locally, rendered from JSON store data instead of the Shopify API, with the HTML Shopify renders. It serves the storefront for end-to-end tests, validates store data, finds and fixes what Shopify's strict Liquid parser rejects, formats Liquid as Prettier does, and profiles pages. Install with `npm install --save-dev local-storefront`; run it as `npx local-storefront <command>` (never `npx lsf`, another package).

Commands are non-interactive. Exit codes: 0 nothing to report, 1 something to fix, 2 the command could not run. `npx local-storefront validate --format json` and `npx local-storefront check --format json` print machine-readable diagnostics.
